summary: On Holding AG filed a Form 6-K on May 28, 2026, reporting the results of its Annual General Meeting (AGM) held the same day. The filing covers routine items: acknowledgment of financial statements, discharge of directors, re-election of board members and co-chairmen, appointment of auditors and compensation committee, and advisory votes on compensation. No special-situation terms (stakes, prices, premiums, advisors, or structural mechanics) are present. As a routine meeting notice without forced management changes or strategic catalysts, this is not a special situation. What to watch: none — purely procedural governance update.
